To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we introduce a dataset and a method to discover states and transformations in collections of images.

(1) we introduce a dataset with 10 object categories, each of which appears in 10 different states; (2) we learn a generative model that describes the appearance of objects in different states; and (3) we show how to use this model to interpret a novel collection of objects, scenes and materials, by explaining the collection as the result of transformations on a small number of objects.

we introduce a new dataset of images of objects, scenes and materials that are transformed in a variety of ways; we introduce a new system for learning the transformations that objects undergo; we introduce a novel approach to generalizing the learned transformations to novel object categories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
discovering and understanding transformations in image collections, and we hope it will help us learn more about the physical world and its inhabitants.
